invariants.claim: The continuing path starts in Active with totalEntries > 0 and block.timestamp in the half-open interval [endTime, endTime + 2 days).
Before the state-changing wrapper request, status is Drawing, drawRequestedAt is recorded, and _requestInFlight is true.
The request uses fixed callbackGasLimit and requestConfirmations, asks for exactly one word, and encodes nativePayment=true.
On normal return, paidPrice <= msg.value, vrfRequestId equals the returned requestId, _requestInFlight is false, and all excess over paidPrice has either been zero or sent successfully to msg.sender.
Changing status to Drawing freezes the positive totalEntries value because buyEntries requires Active; fulfillRandomWords later uses that frozen value as its modulo divisor and reserve comparator.
The nonReentrant guard is entered before any requestDraw body logic and remains entered through both wrapper interactions and the requester refund, then is restored after the body.

calls.propagates: Rejects an already-ENTERED fixed guard slot, marks it ENTERED for the full body, and restores NOT_ENTERED afterward (target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L72, L88-L105).
Establishes status == Active on the continuing path and reverts otherwise (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L241, L571-L575).
Returns uint256(endTime) + DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT for the exclusive request-window upper bound (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L244-L247, L458-L460).
Forwards the first one-word native price query to the configured wrapper; its returned value or revert propagates (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L249-L250, L435-L438).

Supplies both the preliminary quote and the second price attached to the request; implementation paths are unavailable, so revert and ABI-decodable return behavior remain externally defined (IVRFV2PlusWrapper.sol:L23-L33; VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L82-L88).

ABI-encodes the V1 extra-arguments selector and nativePayment=true without branches (target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/vrf/dev/libraries/VRFV2PlusClient.sol:L5-L11, L22-L26).

Performs the second price read, sends exactly that value with the configured confirmations/gas/one-word request, and returns the wrapper ID plus its locally read price (VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L76-L88).
The caller relies on successful return to represent an accepted request and on the returned uint256 to identify its later callback; the implementation is not present (IVRFV2PlusWrapper.sol:L67-L81).
Receives excess with empty calldata and all remaining gas; arbitrary execution or revert is possible, and only the success bit is checked (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L262-L269).
Returns zero for a zero drawRequestedAt, otherwise drawRequestedAt + DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT; requestDraw uses it in the final event (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L272, L463-L465).

callers: Any external account or contract can call the external payable entrypoint; source imposes lifecycle/time/value gates rather than a caller role (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L240-L250; target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L316-L320).

No first-party Solidity call site appears in target; the source-visible protocol surface is the implementation and IRaffle declaration (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L240; target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L320).
sharedState: status: activated by onERC721Received, read/written by requestDraw, consumed/written by enableRefunds and fulfillRandomWords, and read by later settlement/redemption paths (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L241-L252, L276-L300, L416-L429, L509-L523, L533-L557).

endTime: initialized from factory-validated configuration, read directly and through drawRequestDeadline by requestDraw and enableRefunds (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L204, L242-L247, L286-L287, L458-L460; target/packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L99-L104).

totalEntries: advanced only by Active purchases, required nonzero by requestDraw, then frozen for callback selection/reserve comparison (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L215-L233, L243, L252, L518-L521).

vrfRequestId, drawRequestedAt, and _requestInFlight: written only by requestDraw and consumed by callbackDeadline, enableRefunds, and fulfillRandomWords (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L108-L112, L141-L142, L252-L260, L289-L291, L463-L465, L509-L515).

ReentrancyGuard fixed slot: shared with every nonReentrant Raffle entrypoint and held ENTERED for the full requestDraw execution (target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol:L35-L37, L69-L72, L94-L105; target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L209-L212, L240, L276, L304, L309, L349, L375, L385, L395).

Native balance: msg.value funds requestDraw, the second wrapper price leaves through the wrapper call, excess leaves through the requester call, and inherited getBalance exposes the remainder (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L240-L270; VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L82-L88, L109-L112).
